image_description: A side-profile view of an adult male rooster (cock) standing on dry, dusty ground. The bird features a bright red comb and wattles, golden-orange hackle feathers, dark iridescent body plumage, and long, curved black tail feathers. Its legs are yellow with visible scales, and it stands in an alert posture.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible foot shows the correct toe arrangement (anisodactyl) and sharp claws.
